Marissa / team — drafted the one-page retention & auditing map and a short SOC2 checklist. Sharing here as inline — I will attach the formal doc in the next version.

---
Data retention and audit map (summary)
- Model requests: ephemeral tokenization, request logs kept 30 days by default, option for customer-managed KV retention policy
- Audit logs: Admin changes and key rotations retained 365 days (can be exported to customer S3)
- Access patterns: role-based access control, IAM bindings, and recommended least-privilege roles for dev/test/prod
- SOC2 notes: we can provide exported syslogs + appendix for your compliance review; suggest 2-3 weeks for evidence turnaround.
---

Happy to polish this into the one-pager and the exec slide. Quick Q: does Easton want explicit wording around deletion guarantees in the pre-read or keep that for procurement?
